usedFor: TimeRex takes the bookings, and Google Drive gets a prepared copy of a file through “Copy a File”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Event” in TimeRex, then “Copy a File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: Each new event gets its own copy of a file, such as a notes page, in a folder you pick.

watchOut: “Event Rescheduled” is its own trigger, so a reschedule does not repeat “Copy a File” unless you use it.
